==Description==
The '''Skeleton''' was an enemy that appeared in the [[The Haunted Past|second act]] of the [[Lunar Overture Event]]. It had a high amount of health for its debut but was rather slow. On specific waves, it would spawn as a hidden enemy.

==Appearance==
The '''Skeleton''' was made entirely of white parts that resembled a skeletal humanoid. It did not have a full torso, though it had a partial ribcage. Its head was slightly smaller than most other enemies and had two large black eyeholes.

On death, the '''Skeleton''' would fall into a pile of bones while playing a bone shaking sound.

==Strategy==
*Cheap towers with decent DPS, such as the [[Golden Soldier]], [[Ace Pilot]] or [[Golden Scout]] are recommended against this.
*As these spawn in hordes, area of effect towers like the [[Mortar]] or [[Golden Pyromancer]] can be very useful against them.
*In later waves, this enemy spawns as hidden. However, by this point you should have high DPS towers with hidden detection, making them quite easy to kill.
